entities.name: Kynureninase sequence
observations: 428 aa bacterial protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A4IT57 from Geobacillus thermodenitrificans.
Predicted molecular weight 48,332.756 Da, theoretical pI 5.894, and charge at pH 7 of -8.25.
Exact-match annotation identifies a PLP-dependent kynureninase, EC 3.7.1.3, functioning as a homodimer in the cytoplasm.
The sequence contains Pfam Aminotran_5 (PF00266.26; residues 85–376) and KYNU_C (PF22580.3; residues 319–408).
The conserved PLP-linked lysine is at residue 239 in the exact reference annotation.

entities.name: Kynurenine cleavage
observations: L-kynurenine + H2O → anthranilate + L-alanine + H(+); mapped to Rhea RHEA:16813 and EC 3.7.1.3.

entities.name: 3-Hydroxykynurenine cleavage
observations: 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + H2O → 3-hydroxyanthranilate + L-alanine + H(+); mapped to Rhea RHEA:25143 and EC 3.7.1.3.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5-phosphate
observations: Required cofactor for the kynureninase reaction; the enzyme is a PLP-dependent cleavage enzyme.

entities.name: Kynurenine degradation
observations: The enzyme catalyzes the entry/terminal cleavage step producing anthranilate and L-alanine from L-kynurenine.

entities.name: NAD+ biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme contributes to quinolinate formation from L-kynurenine, annotated as step 2 of 3 in NAD+ biosynthesis.
